clients.description: OAuth clients accepted by the authorization server.

crypto.description: External file containing encryption secrets and signing key pairs.

tokens.description: Lifetimes, in seconds, for OAuth tokens and authorization codes.

client_id.description: Public identifier of the OAuth client.

client_secret.description: Secret used to authenticate the OAuth client at the token endpoint.

federated_server.description: Upstream OAuth server used to federate identities for this client.

public.description: Host used to resolve dynamic `username@host` client identifiers.

qr_code.description: Render wallet authorization URLs as QR-code HTML instead of redirects.

redirect_uris.description: Exact redirect URIs accepted for authorization responses.

require_wallet_binding.description:
Require wallet proofs and presentations to be bound to the public key
from the ID token carried by the incoming authorization code.

key_file.description: YAML file loaded once at startup with encryption secrets and signing keys.

claim.description: Dot-separated JSON claim path read from the endpoint response.

endpoint.description: Endpoint called with the federated bearer access token.

target.description: Authorize request identity field populated from the claim.

authorize_endpoint.description: Federated server endpoint to which authorization requests are sent.

client_id.description: Client identifier used to authenticate Kagome to the federated server.

client_secret.description: Client secret used to authenticate Kagome to the federated server.

endpoints.description: Federated endpoints used to obtain identity claims with the access token.

token_endpoint.description: Federated server endpoint at which authorization codes are exchanged.

address.description: Socket address on which the HTTP server listens.

issuer.description: Public HTTP origin used to construct callback URLs.

workers.description: Number of HTTP request worker threads.

access_token_ttl.description: Lifetime of an access token, in seconds.

authorization_code_ttl.description: Lifetime of an authorization code, in seconds.

id_token_ttl.description: Lifetime of an ID token, in seconds.
